name: Arch Ferment
source: Yunoka's form when she is transformed by the power of the light armor, Musashi. Unlike her shy self prior the transformation, she fights aggressively as Arch Ferment to defeat evildoers. She wields two unsigned katanas, a long sword, Kin (Gold), and a wakizashi, Gin (Silver). With unparallel speed, she roams the battlefield slashing down enemies left and right. Her finishing move is Kobokumei (Leafless Tree's Cry), slash attacks of divine speed.
